method: Codex actually inspected all 30 chronological continuous frames (15fps, 2 seconds) from this regenerated library sample using view_image, checking motion, alpha edges, shape preservation and canvas containment. observation: 火焰图标按默认1.4秒周期左右平移摇曳，换向连续；火苗尖部及黄橙内焰保持清楚，没有被拉伸、越界或套入不透明底框。
